title: gypsocallis villosa
intro: Gypsocallis villosa, commonly known as the woolly gypsophila, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. The health benefits of Gypsocallis villosa include its potential to treat digestive issues and reduce inflammation due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, although further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its bioactive compounds.
